# FlowControlElement { #timetoalign.timelines.FlowControlElement }

```python
timelines.FlowControlElement(
    coordinate,
    *,
    id=None,
    _minted=False,
    _unknown_keys=dict[str, Any](),
    name=None,
    label=None,
    meta=dict[str, Any](),
    provenance=None,
)
```

What the five kinds of flow-control element share.

An element lies at one coordinate of its timeline's axis and is written
in a manifest as one object of the timeline's ``flow_control``, its
``role`` naming its class. Keys the library does not know are kept and
written back.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name       | Type                                                                                    | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| coordinate | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`)                                             | Where the element lies.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| name       | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                    | A display name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| label      | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                    | A human-readable label.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| meta       | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\]                                     | Additional metadata.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| provenance | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[Provenance](`timetoalign.core.provenance.Provenance`), ...\] \| None | How the element was made and who believes it: one or more provenance entries, or None. A single entry given is held as the list of that entry. An element is never changed or deleted to repair flow control: it is rejected by a belief (:meth:`with_belief`), and another one added. |
| id         | [str](`str`)                                                                            | The element's ID; minted from its role when not given.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

### from_dict { #timetoalign.timelines.FlowControlElement.from_dict }

```python
timelines.FlowControlElement.from_dict(data, *, unit, number_type)
```

Restore an element from its object in a ``flow_control`` array.

Called on :class:`FlowControlElement`, the element's ``role`` picks
the class; called on one of the five classes, the role must be that
class's. ``coordinate`` and every ``by`` are bare values on the
timeline's axis, which *unit* and *number_type* describe. ``name``,
``label``, ``meta`` and ``provenance`` (a list of provenance
entries) may be left out; keys the library does not know are kept
and written back.

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                                              |
|--------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the element is malformed, is written in the form with ``type`` and ``target``, has another role than the class's, or a value is no value of the axis. |

### with_belief { #timetoalign.timelines.FlowControlElement.with_belief }

```python
timelines.FlowControlElement.with_belief(belief, *, context=None)
```

A copy of the element whose provenance holds *belief*.

Only the provenance changes. The belief replaces its actor's earlier
one in every entry holding one
(:meth:`Provenance.with_belief
<timetoalign.core.provenance.Provenance.with_belief>`); where the
actor holds none, the first entry records it, and an element
without provenance gets one entry holding the belief alone. Every
other actor's belief stands. A registry records a belief in an
element it holds with :meth:`FlowControlRegistry.with_belief`.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type                                                                              | Description                                                                      | Default    |
|---------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| belief  | [Belief](`timetoalign.core.provenance.Belief`)                                    | The belief; ``"false"`` rejects the element.                                     | _required_ |
| context | [Mapping](`collections.abc.Mapping`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] \| None | The JSON-LD context under which actors compare as IRIs; None declares no prefix. | `None`     |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from timetoalign.core import Coordinate, TimeUnit
>>> from timetoalign.core.provenance import Belief
>>> barline = Barline(Coordinate(8, TimeUnit.quarters))
>>> rejected = barline.with_belief(
...     Belief(actor="ana", belief="false", date="2026-11-25")
... )
>>> barline.is_rejected, rejected.is_rejected
(False, True)
>>> rejected.to_dict()["provenance"]
[{'beliefs': [{'actor': 'ana', 'belief': 'false', 'date': '2026-11-25'}]}]
```
